g.text: Trigger height changed despite controlled bed and nozzle setpoints
Bed target 60 deg C; nozzle target 140 deg C. Each phase uses its own baseline. Cooling returns to the bed every 15 s.
One run per phase. Probe-body temperature and independent physical displacement were not measured.
